Build the project from sources.

Usage:
  app build <target> [extra...] [flags]

Arguments:
  <target>      what to build
  [extra...]    extra targets

Flags:
  -o,--output string    output directory (default ./dist)
  --format string       archive format (default tar) [tar|zip]
  -f,--force            overwrite existing output (required)
  --legacy              legacy flag (deprecated: use --modern)

Examples:
  app build ./src
  app build ./src --force
